record.question: Which of these conditions is an example of pathologic hyperplasia?
options: Compensatory hyperplasia of the liver after partial hepatectomy
Hyperplasia of the uterine lining due to excessive estrogen
An increase in number of cells during wound healing
record.explanation: Answer C: Hyperplasia of the uterine lining due to excessive estrogen. Excess estrogen can drive endometrial hyperplasia and is a pathologic stimulus; liver regeneration, pubertal breast growth, and wound-healing proliferation are physiologic/adaptive responses. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK557575/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
